name: pokemon-companion
description: Seven animated Pokémon help your AI control Windows through native APIs, keyboard input, and screenshots when needed.
long_description: Install, enable, and ask your AI to use Pokémon Companion. Includes Pikachu, Riolu, Lucario, Clodsire, Bulbasaur, Charmander, and Squirtle. Node, Electron, and native dependencies are included. Left-click the Pokémon to switch characters, open Talk, or exit. Talk remains a separate character conversation and does not forward messages to your AI chat.
